articles.title: Fire Breaks Out in Smallbridge, Rochdale
articles.excerpt: A fire broke out in Smallbridge, Rochdale, on Friday evening, leading to significant damage and a response from firefighters and environmental officials.
articles.content_html:
A fire broke out in an open area on Spring Mill Walk in Smallbridge at around 8:15pm on Friday, July 24. Aerial images captured the impact of the fire, which burned overnight and produced large plumes of black smoke visible across Rochdale.

Firefighters worked throughout the night to extinguish the fire and remained on the scene until around 1pm on Saturday, damping down hotspots and monitoring the aftermath. Dramatic photos shared on social media showed the extent of the fire's reach.

The fire involved a large quantity of waste at the site, prompting officials from the Environment Agency to be called in, along with the local council. Pictures taken by a drone later revealed a significant area of scorched earth and debris left behind by the incident.

The response to the fire has raised concerns about the environmental impact, and investigations are likely to follow regarding the cause and management of the waste involved.
